correctness.rationale: The cyclic ordered pair histogram necessarily has p01=p10=t and p=(n-k-t,t,t,k-t); all t>=1, t<=k<=n-t are realized by explicit run words, plus two constant profiles. Replacing at most one observed pair label gives integer-histogram distance half L1, equal to max(|Δk|,|Δt|)+|Δt|. Disjoint radius-one corruption balls therefore require distance>=3. At length 4m the source partitions D_4m into m² four-point diameter-two cliques using first two transition rows and shifted D_4(m-1); each selected residue k-2t=0 mod4 is pairwise distance>=3 and meets each clique once. Add two constants to get A(4m)=m²+2. Embedding feasible profiles into longer lengths proves the floor/ceil general n bounds. Independently verified selected-code sizes and pairwise distances for m=1..9; analytical clique induction establishes all m.
